name: setegid
description: setegid() sets the effective group ID of the calling process. Unprivileged processes may only set the effective group ID to the real group ID, the effective group ID, or the saved set-group-ID.

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set

errors.description: The target group ID is not valid in this user namespace.
The calling process is not privileged and egid does not match the current real group ID, current effective group ID, or current saved set-group-ID.

versions: Linux 1.1.37 and later, with glibc implementation changes in versions 2.0, 2.1, and 2.2/2.3
